  LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_reserve" AS lr

  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_coverage_detail" AS pcd

   AND pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
),
claim_losses AS (
  SELECT
    cp.Policy_Identifier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cp.Claim_Identifier) AS claims,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_payment" AS lp
          WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
        )
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_reserve" AS lr
          WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
        )
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."expense_payment" AS ep
          WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
        )
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."expense_reserve" AS er
          WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
        )
        THEN ca.Claim_Amount

    ) AS total_loss
